channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump announces plan for $15 billion steel plant, would be largest in U.S. history
item.description: Trump's announcement with Mesabi Metallics comes as Americans' souring views of the economy are poised to shape the upcoming midterm election.

item.title: AMD acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs AI firm in deal worth $8.2 billion
item.description: AMD previously invested in World Labs before the acquisition, which is the chipmaker's second biggest on record.

item.title: Supreme Court Justice Alito will not participate in big climate change case next week
item.description: Environmental groups had called for Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito to recuse himself from the case involving ExxonMobil and Suncor Energy.

item.title: Boeing 737 Max 10 certification delayed by software issue, FAA says
item.description: The FAA administrator said the Max 10 will be delayed until the agency can assess a software issue on the aircraft.

item.title: LeBron James is already boosting ticket and merchandise demand for Philadelphia 76ers
item.description: NBA star LeBron James is having a major financial impact on the Philadelphia 76ers and Philadelphia, boosting sponsorships, ticket sales, and economic activity

item.title: Michael Burry believes the AI bubble 'may burst' sooner than he first believed
item.description: The famed short seller is switching to puts with expiries in June for his major tech short bets.

item.title: A relief rally could be coming soon for these stocks getting hurt by higher rates, says Katie Stockton
item.description: The deeply oversold condition of the utilities sector increases the likelihood of a short-term relief rally over the coming weeks, says Stockton.

item.title: OpenAI sparked Hugging Face bids with early investment offer ahead of Nvidia's $13 billion deal
item.description: Hugging Face saw a flurry of deal interest before Nvidia agreed to buy the open-source platform for roughly $13 billion, CNBC has learned.

item.title: Nvidia share buyback plan gets $150 billion boost
item.description: Nvidia said the buyback boost marks the largest share repurchase authorization increase in history.

item.title: Anthropic launches cheaper AI model, its second release since CEO's call for a slowdown
item.description: The company said Sonnet 5.5 doesn't advance the frontier, but that it is better at coding and knowledge work tasks than its predecessor.

item.title: SpaceX launches its massive Starship rocket into orbit for the first time
item.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX launched a historic test flight of its massive Starship rocket early Monday.

item.title: Elon Musk, SpaceXAI subpoenaed by NYC in AI safety investigation
item.description: The New York City Council issued a subpoena to Musk, requiring that he or another representative of SpaceXAI testify in an investigation concerning AI safety.

item.title: Meta's Muse agent is attacking one of the economy's most profitable weak spots
item.description: Meta's Muse AI personal agent will work over your credit card spending if you don't mind the invasion. How big a threat is it to the subscription economy?

item.title: Feds can't withhold counterterrorism funds from states to force election admin changes, judge rules
item.description: The judge said FEMA never explained how the election changes it wanted were "tied to the goal of shoring up vulnerabilities to terrorist attacks."

item.title: Nearly half the stocks in the S&P 500 are at cross purposes with the rest of the market
item.description: Almost half of the stocks in the S&P 500 have a negative beta, evidence of a chasm between the entire index and its individual components.

item.title: Higher rates will create winners and losers in bonds, says UBS. Where the bank sees opportunity
item.description: The caliber of bonds matters, especially the higher rates go, UBS says.

item.title: A key test looms for the AI trade this week. Here's how Mike Khouw is trading it
item.description: Micron reports after the bell Wednesday.

item.title: Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead enterprise unit. MongoDB shares crater
item.description: Desai will lead the new Meta Enterprise Platform unit and report to CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

item.title: Senate tees up college sports bill aimed at regulating NIL deals
item.description: The Senate is due to vote Monday on the bill, which would create a national framework for name, image and likeness deals in college athletics.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hires Wall Street economist David Zervos
item.description: Zervos is joining the Treasury Department as counselor to Bessent, adding a prominent markets voice to the administration's economic policy team.

item.title: Meta's splashy new business AI hire offers yet another reason to bank on Zuckerberg
item.description: By poaching MongoDB's CJ Desai, Mark Zuckerberg shows he's serious about building an enterprise AI business.

item.title: The warning signs your debt may be a problem, according to a credit counselor — and what to do first
item.description: There's no dollar amount that makes debt "a problem." Here's what actually signals trouble.

item.title: Many homeowners have a big insurance coverage gap — and don't even know it
item.description: Many consumers have a gap in their homeowners insurance coverage. This puts them at financial risk, and they are likely unaware, experts said.

item.title: IRS hires Joseph Velli to help administer Trump accounts
item.description: Velli previously served on the boards of Paychex, Cognizant and Computershare.

item.title: Ex-Disney CEO Bob Chapek says he raised concerns with the board 'weekly' during Iger power battle
item.description: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek was ousted from his role as CEO in late 2022, less than three years after taking the post, and replaced by Iger.

item.title: Trump ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban as global supply crunch worsens
item.description: Analysts warn an export ban could backfire, pushing up global diesel prices and potentially triggering higher U.S. gasoline prices as refiners adjust.

item.title: Five arrested over alleged bomb plot at UK air base used by U.S.; Iran denies link
item.description: U.K. counterterrorism police are understood to be investigating a potential link with Iran after an alleged bomb threat against an air base hosting U.S. forces.

item.title: Treasury yields rise as march to multiyear highs continues
item.description: Treasury yields edged higher on Monday as investors look ahead to fresh economic data releases this week.

item.title: Oil prices off highs after reports Saudi pipeline ramping back up
item.description: The Saudis shutdown the pipeline earlier this month after it sustained damage in a drone strike launched form Iraq.

item.title: Which 10-year yield level will really start to hit stocks? Here's what history suggests
item.description: The record suggests that the 10-year yield will have to approach 7% in order to meaningfully hurt stocks, according to Bank of America.
